preconditions.description: The integer n must be between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= f[i] <= n for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: All values in the function f must be integers between 1 and n inclusive.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if not valid else True
postconditions.description: If no valid functions g and h exist, output -1.
The integer m must be between 1 and 1,000,000 inclusive if valid functions g and h exist.
The length of g must be n and the length of h must be m if valid functions g and h exist.

postconditions.expression: all(g[h[i]] == i for i in range(m))
postconditions.description: For all i in [m], g(h(i)) must equal i if valid functions g and h exist.

postconditions.expression: all(h[g[i]] == f[i] for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: For all i in [n], h(g(i)) must equal f(i) if valid functions g and h exist.
